assets.subject: worn honey-brown wooden floor planks
assets.detail: Long straight planks about 8 inches wide running top to bottom (about 7 planks across the square), worn smooth in the middle, a few nail heads, butt joints staggered. A tavern floor.

assets.subject: dark oak floor boards
assets.detail: Dark brown oak boards about 7 inches wide running top to bottom, scuffed and darkened by years of boots, staggered joints, a few iron nails.

assets.subject: wooden planks strewn with dried rushes
assets.detail: Warm wooden planks about 8 inches wide running top to bottom, loosely strewn with dried rushes, straw and a few herbs, as in a medieval hall. The planks stay visible under the scatter.

assets.subject: polished fitted floorboards
assets.detail: Fine, tightly fitted warm golden-brown boards about 6 inches wide running top to bottom, softly polished, a wealthy guest room.

assets.subject: herringbone wooden parquet
assets.detail: Herringbone parquet of short warm wooden blocks about 12 inches long, two alternating wood tones, a noble's chamber.

assets.subject: stained tavern floor planks
assets.detail: Honey wooden planks about 8 inches wide running top to bottom with old ale stains, a dark spill ring and worn patches. A busy tavern floor.

assets.subject: rough split boards with gaps
assets.detail: Rough, uneven split boards about 10 inches wide running top to bottom with dark gaps between them and splintered ends. A poor outbuilding or privy floor.

assets.subject: irregular blue-gray flagstones
assets.detail: Irregular blue-gray flagstones of mixed sizes (1 to 2 feet across) set in pale mortar, gently worn. A kitchen or hall floor.

assets.subject: dressed square stone slabs
assets.detail: Dressed square gray stone slabs about 20 inches on a side in a regular staggered grid with thin mortar lines, slightly worn.

assets.subject: damp mossy cellar flagstones
assets.detail: Uneven dark flagstones with damp patches and a little moss in the joints, cool blue-gray and green. A cellar floor.

assets.subject: rounded cobblestones
assets.detail: Rounded gray and ochre cobblestones about 5 inches across packed tightly in dirt. A stable or yard floor.

assets.subject: worn red brick in herringbone
assets.detail: Worn red-brown bricks laid in a herringbone pattern, about 8 by 4 inches each, sooty and uneven. A kitchen floor.

assets.subject: terracotta floor tiles
assets.detail: Square terracotta tiles about 10 inches on a side in warm orange-ochre tones with thin pale grout, gently worn.

assets.subject: cream and slate checkered stone
assets.detail: A checkerboard of cream limestone and dark slate squares about 15 inches on a side (4 squares across), polished but worn. A castle or noble floor.

assets.subject: packed earth floor
assets.detail: Hard-packed brown earth with subtle footworn ruts, a few pebbles and dust. A barn, privy or peasant hut floor.

assets.subject: earth floor scattered with straw
assets.detail: Packed brown earth generously scattered with loose golden straw and hay. A stable or barn floor.
